#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

struct BitSet {
    unsigned long long lo, hi;
    void set(int x) {
        if (x < 64) lo |= 1ULL << x;
        else hi |= 1ULL << (x - 64);
    }
    void reset() { lo = hi = 0; }
    BitSet& operator|=(const BitSet& o) { lo |= o.lo; hi |= o.hi; return *this; }
    bool operator==(const BitSet& o) const { return lo == o.lo && hi == o.hi; }
    bool operator[](int x) const {
        return x < 64 ? (lo >> x) & 1 : (hi >> (x - 64)) & 1;
    }
    bool operator<(const BitSet& o) const {
        return hi < o.hi || (hi == o.hi && lo < o.lo);
    }
};

ll fpm(ll a, ll b) {
    ll c = 1;
    for (; b; b >>= 1, a = a * a % MOD)
        if (b & 1) c = c * a % MOD;
    return c;
}

int n;
ll a[11][11];
ll f[11][131];
int is[131];
ll i100;
map<BitSet, ll> st[8];
BitSet mx, stt;

ll dfs(int x, BitSet w) {
    if (x == n) return w == mx ? 1 : 0;
    auto it = st[x].find(w);
    if (it != st[x].end()) return it->second;
    ll ans = 0;
    BitSet s[11];
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) s[j].reset();
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) if (w[i])
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) if (!(i & (1 << j)))
            s[j].set(i | (1 << j));
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
        BitSet ng = w;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) if (i & (1 << j)) ng |= s[j];
        ans = (ans + f[x][i] * dfs(x + 1, ng)) % MOD;
    }
    return st[x][w] = ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(0);
    cin >> n;
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) mx.set(i);
    stt.set(0);
    i100 = fpm(100, MOD - 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> a[i][j];
            a[i][j] = a[i][j] * i100 % MOD;
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) is[1 << i] = i;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); ++j) {
            f[i][j] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k)
                if (j & (1 << k))
                    f[i][j] = f[i][j] * a[k][i] % MOD;
                else
                    f[i][j] = f[i][j] * (MOD + 1 - a[k][i]) % MOD;
        }
    cout << dfs(0, stt) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
